records.text: On July 13, 2024, a 20-year-old Thomas Matthew Crooks climbed onto a roof and tried to assassinate President Donald Trump, and one supporter, Corey Comparatore, a 50-year-old firefighter, lost his life trying to save his children
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Which brings me to Thomas Matthew Crooks because that's exactly what we were told—or not told—when, on July 13th, 2024, a 20-year-old Thomas Matthew Crooks climbs onto a roof and tries to assassinate President Donald Trump. Gratefully, Donald Trump did not die, but tragically, one of his supporters did, okay? A 50-year-old firefighter named Corey Comparatore lost his life trying to save his children.

records.text: Candace Owens said Corey Comperatore was the longtime high-school friend to whom Mark A. Liti confided that he had done something he was not supposed to do.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Mark Liti's friend's name was Corey Comperatore. Yes, it was Corey Comperatore who Mark Liti had confided his secret to, that he had done something that he wasn't supposed to.

verification.notes: Live research did not locate a reliable public source establishing that Corey Comperatore and Mark A. Liti were longtime high-school friends or that Liti confided wrongdoing to Comperatore. The claim depends on unnamed private sourcing.

records.text: Candace Owens said an unknown woman unexpectedly escorted Corey Comperatore and his family from the general crowd to the front of Donald Trump's Butler rally.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In fact, Corey (Corey Comperatore) had grabbed regular tickets for he and his family. They were amongst the crowd. So they were quite surprised when while waiting in a large crowd, an unknown woman asked them if they'd like to be escorted. ... To the very front, who was this woman? Surely with so many cameras reporting live from the rally, someone must have captured this moment.

verification.notes: No authoritative rally record, family interview, contemporaneous video, or reliable report located verifies that an unknown woman unexpectedly moved the Comperatore family from general admission to the front.

records.text: Candace Owens said Corey Comperatore was then shot in the head at the Butler rally.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Corey Comperatore then is shot in the head.

verification.notes: Local and national reporting identifies Corey Comperatore as the rally attendee shot in the head and killed while shielding his family at the Butler rally.

sources.title: Secret Service has blood on their hands after Trump rally shooting, family says
sources.relevance: Reports that Corey Comperatore was shot in the head and killed at the Butler rally.

records.text: An unnamed authority said Corey Comperatore's widow and family were dissatisfied with the Butler investigation, the answers about his death, and the lack of Secret Service job losses.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 5NQyGuRYbU8)

appearances.snippet: I have it on authority the widow of Corey Comperatore and the family of Corey Comperatore is not like Trump (Donald Trump). They are not satisfied with the investigation. They are not happy with the fact that Secret Service agents never lost their jobs. ... They are not satisfied with the answers that they are receiving about how Corey Comperatore was killed. Imagine that.

verification.notes: Interviews with Corey Comperatore’s widow and family members document dissatisfaction with the investigation, unanswered questions, and criticism that suspensions without firings were insufficient.

appearances.snippet: And they can't even imagine themselves asking this question. We revisit the Butler assassination and speculated that Corey Comperatore, the only person who lost his life on that day, may have even been targeted.

records.text: Helen Comperatore said she did not believe there was another shooter, but believed Thomas Matthew Crooks was working with somebody and that the attack was an inside job somewhere in government.
records.speaker: Helen Comperatore

appearances.snippet: I don't believe there was another shooter there, but I believe that he was working with somebody. ... I believe it was inside, it was an inside job inside the government somewhere.

records.text: Helen Comperatore asked President Donald Trump not to forget the family, to remember what they went through, and to help them get answers.
records.speaker: Helen Comperatore

appearances.snippet: to don't forget us and remember what we went through that day. ... You know, we're still here and we need answers.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting of the NewsNation interview quotes Helen Comperatore asking President Trump not to forget the family, to remember what they endured, and saying they still needed answers.
